title: Without RELATEDTABLE or CALCULATE a row context on the one side does not filter the many side
query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS ( Product, "Product", Product[Product], "Amount", SUMX ( Sales, Sales[Amount] ) )

source.quote: By default, the row context does not propagate through relationships
source.supports: a row context does not propagate through relationships

derivation: There is no context transition, so Sales is not filtered by the current Product row: every row gets the total, 100 + 40 + 20 + 50 + 200 + 30 + 100 = 540.
